examples.japanese: よく{本|ほん}を{読|よ}みます。
よくここに{来|き}ますか？
{子供|こども}の{時|とき}、よく{外|そと}で{遊|あそ}びました。
examples.english: When I was a child, I often played outside.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}はよく「{早|はや}く{寝|ね}なさい」と{言|い}います。
examples.english: My mother often says, "Go to bed early."

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}とよく{電話|でんわ}で{話|はな}すので、いつも{電話代|でんわだい}が{高|たか}くなってしまいます。
examples.english: I often talk to my friends on the phone, so my phone bill always ends up being high.

examples.japanese: よく{見|み}て、まねしてください。
examples.english: Watch carefully, and copy what I do.

examples.japanese: よくできました！{次|つぎ}も{頑張|がんば}ってください。
examples.english: Well done! Keep up the good work.

examples.japanese: {説明|せつめい}をよく{読|よ}んでから、{使|つか}い{方|かた}がわからない{時|とき}は{先生|せんせい}に{聞|き}いてください。
examples.english: After reading the instructions carefully, if you still don't understand how to use it, please ask the teacher.

notes:
よく has two main meanings: "often" and "well" (adverb of いい).

MEANINGS:
1. Often, frequently (with actions)
2. Well, thoroughly (adverb of いい)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- よく{読|よ}む: to read often; to read carefully
- よく{分|わ}かる: to understand well
- よくできました: Well done!
- よく{来|き}ましたね: Welcome! (I'm glad you came)

FREQUENCY SCALE:
- いつも: always
- よく: often
- {時々|ときどき}: sometimes
- たまに: occasionally
- {全然|ぜんぜん}〜ない: never

Note: Context determines which meaning applies.
